description: Defines the Subunit entity class for the OrangeHRM system, representing organizational subunits with nested set hierarchy support, including properties like id, name, unitId, description, lft, rgt, level, and node management methods.

classes.name: Subunit
classes.description: Entity class representing a subunit with nested set hierarchy, mapped to 'ohrm_subunit' table.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the subunit.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the subunit.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the subunit.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the subunit.

methods.name: getUnitId
methods.description: Returns the unit ID associated with the subunit.

methods.name: setUnitId
methods.description: Sets the unit ID associated with the subunit.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the subunit.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the subunit.

methods.name: getLft
methods.description: Returns the left value in nested set hierarchy.

methods.name: setLft
methods.description: Sets the left value in nested set hierarchy.

methods.name: getRgt
methods.description: Returns the right value in nested set hierarchy.

methods.name: setRgt
methods.description: Sets the right value in nested set hierarchy.

methods.name: getLevel
methods.description: Returns the level in nested set hierarchy.

methods.name: setLevel
methods.description: Sets the level in nested set hierarchy.

methods.name: getNode
methods.description: Returns the Node object representing this subunit in the nested set.

methods.name: setNode
methods.description: Sets the Node object for this subunit.
